body:
WIP（2026-10-08）：bounded portable typed-property mapper 已实际实现、测试并作为 source handoff 发布。远端精确 SHA `fb4d18e9342716def4dca6a73d102f7246e42846`，分支 `codex/chain-3663-portable-property-mapping`；唯一当前增量范围为 `f4600360c7d2847f048ebc5465baae052aa7efe8..fb4d18e9342716def4dca6a73d102f7246e42846`（5 files）。原 foundation 草稿 PR #3888 保持 head `49e7118a384df5d5019b435ceb362320e3d917f8`；canonical typed 输入仍为 #3735 提供的 `6a1cd4594763b1a3397f5fca6309df4297d54042`，未消费移动 PR head。当前已 fetch/核验 origin/master `53da546cc8ab9fd8603067395d988b7ddb650394`；未合并或重放跨链冲突。

新增 shared `ArticlePackagePropertyMappingBindings` / immutable candidate 与 backend `ArticlePackagePropertyMapper.TryMapCandidate`、`ValidateCandidate`：复用 canonical 八类型/snapshot/relation contracts；要求 exact source snapshot coordinates+digest、Definition schema revision/digest 与显式 portable pairs、definition-scoped Option pairs、reference source pairs 与 canonical TargetFacts；拒绝 missing/extra/duplicate/alias/drift。保留 Missing/Null/false/0/empty/default provenance，不生成 IDs、不从 GUID prefix、title、slug、URL、filename 或 array index 推断 authority。Source digests 与独立 framed portable value/mapping digests 分离，validator 重算 actual projection 拒绝 copied-digest tamper；集合有界不可变。Reference facts 仅 shape-checked caller assertions，不能作为 provider observation。

精确候选实际 SDK10.0.302：original backend focused union **317/317 exit0**（69mapper+81inventory+12rawbytes+61checksum+43typed+51trust）；无 stub 的 actual-source strict harness **223/223 exit0**，locked restore与`-warnaserror`；原 strict C# mother-style **3files0violations exit0**；当前5-file naming/PR-body与increment commit-range检查exit0，未修改可信policy或历史provider artifact。Original backend保留1486 source warning lines（changedfiles0），并非完整 strict source gate通过。原`./tools/test.sh backend-unit` **exit1**：真实 cgroup `/..`；docs lint **exit1**：26diagnostics与exact f460 base完全相同，未waive。CI按协调者明确禁用，未dispatch/wait。

#2323/#3735 精确剩余能力请求：actor/site-bound actual persisted immutable snapshot的exact draft/revision/publication读取，返回digest及canonical command/audit/snapshot provenance refs，stale/denied/missing/unavailable闭合失败；**ReadExactAsync是请求名称，现无此API**。现有`IArticlePropertyReferenceValueAuthority.RequireAllowedAsync`还须实际provider/registration、identity/site/read-permission/lifecycle/cardinality/self-cycle核验及observed frozen relation facts/permission-policy provenance。请提供具体提交和isolated PostgreSQL write→exactread、负控、历史不可变、0/1/1000、raw commands/TRX/cleanup证据，可按已就绪能力分批handoff，不必等待整票关闭。

mapper只完成 typed-property subset，不是完整metadata mapper、manifest/privacy/version registry/package semantic digest、archive/export/import/planning/writer/UX/terminal receipt。Title/summary/taxonomy/rights/responsibility与canonical media/syntax/frozen dependency producer仍待实际owner合同。All16 assigned executionissues保持OPEN；完整原验收与parent-created independent exactcandidate review仍未满足。

Evidence（本original cloud environment）：`/workspace/chain-3663-evidence/property-mapping/final-report.json`、`original-trx/original.trx`、`strict-trx/strict.trx`、commands/logs/exits、`all-issue-status.json/md`、`canonical-upstream-request.json`。有限同tree source review未发现mustfix，不能替代parent完整独立审查。Related to #2398, #2408 and #3663；未close/merge/auto-merge/deploy/package publish。


独立小候选已发布：Draft PR https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/pull/4012 ，远端精确 head `a97177cd5d65c08934fb3e97f0479d6a6a44f190`，分支 `codex/chain-3663-property-mapping-review`；直接父提交/实际 master base `0e9dd5751bdd584204fd149bdb1526b97ff682a6`。完整diff12files、2840additions、0deletions：6canonical typedsource/test files +4ownedidentity/mapper/test files逐字与上述明确提交一致，API文档与精确naming manifest；无native/lock/correctness/retirement带入。该小候选实测strict112/112（69mapper+43typed）exit0、C#motherstyle10files0、master12filemetadata/commit-range通过；不能把旧fb4的317/223收据转到此不同组合。

真实source gates仍失败：originalbackend strictlockedrestore NU1004（serverdependencylock）及NU1903（SQLite2.1.11），和fullcode-intent font_theme_admin_pods.hpp:338 no-allocation claim；exact unmodifiedmaster逐项同样复现。docs26诊断与exactbase相同。不是仅cgroup环境问题，未豁免；小draft保持WIP，不mergeeligible。父任务报告原#3568的canonical#3904 source/lock批次在独立审查整合；等待其已验收fullhead/base/evidence，再用批准actualbase复验。不会导入旧49file宽分支、猜测锁commit或修改audit策略。所有#2323/#1808实际观察权限门槛、缺失mapping类别与16票WIP状态继续保留。


2026-10-08 独立 title/summary source capability：新分支 `codex/chain-3663-title-summary-mapping` 已推送并核验远端精确 SHA `0c778b16f664a91d19b42b9dd26cb1ffe8e76140`。直接父提交 `a97177cd5d65c08934fb3e97f0479d6a6a44f190`；原 draft PR4012保持该精确head未修改。仅新增5files/932additions；master merge-base0e9dd5751bdd584204fd149bdb1526b97ff682a6完整diff16files/3772additions，包含原12file canonical typed/property闭包，无native/locks/retirement或旧宽分支引入。Fetch并核验origin/master `ee808392b54d690d5f99a1e95140bc975a76d5d4`；尚未消费未验收3904批次。

实际API `ArticlePackageTitleSummaryMapper.TryMapCandidate(ArticleCanonicalInput source, ArticlePackageTitleSummaryBinding binding, out candidate)` 和 `ValidateCandidate`，result `IsValid/ReasonCode`。复用真实 `ArticleCanonicalHashV1`（现有RightsSnapshotBuilder/integrity producer的唯一owner），要求source article/revision/revision-number精确正坐标、barelower64hex canonicalhash与显式既有portable Articleidentity；重算整个sourcehash。候选只输出title/nullable summary与绑定，保留null/empty/Unicode/CRLF/LF/trailing/finalnewline；独立domain/LElengthframedmappingdigest和逐字段重算拒绝copied-digest篡改。5stringaggregate≤1048576UTF16codeunits、rawTagCount≤1000、strictUTF8、UTCdate；只读取Count一次并按冻结有界索引复制，无caller枚举fallback。

精确clean SHA实际SDK10.0.302 strict `-warnaserror`+locked restore+NuGetaudit enabled **179/179 exit0**（67新mapper+69propertymapper+43canonicaltyped；包含2Python独立digest向量与dynamicCount/index负控）。strict C# motherstyle3newfiles0violations exit0；使用精确currentmaster ee808 authority对完整16file naming/PR-body与increment commit-range检查exit0。原backend strictlockedrestore仍 **exit1 NU1004+NU1903 SQLite2.1.11**，exactparent同样复现；code-intent原font_theme_admin_pods.hpp:338 no-allocation claim仍exit1；docs26diagnostics与exactparent逐字相同exit1，均未waive。完整backend/runtime未越过sourceadmission，CI按协调者禁用未dispatch。旧317/223/112receipt不转到新候选。

该API是可消费pure bounded title/summary candidate，**不是实际actor/site持久观察、read-permission、privacy admission或publication receipt**。不含lifecycle/taxonomy/rights/responsibility/assets/syntax/media fields，不添加snapshotreader或第二manifest/identitycatalog。#2323/#1808实际reader/provider/frozen provenance与剩余metadata/mediaauthority请求不变。全部16ownedissues保持OPEN。原#3904/#3568 approved fullhead/base/evidence到达后才能消费批准actualbase并复验，不能猜短锁SHA或自行更新locks。

新draft PR已准备完整body与本地metadata证据，但GitHub两次以 `GraphQL: was submitted too quickly (createPullRequest)` 拒绝创建；当前只有usable published branch，**没有新PR URL**。频率限制恢复后用此精确branch和已保存body创建draft/master；PR4012保持冻结。Evidence：`/workspace/chain-3663-evidence/title-summary/final-report.json`、`final-trx/final-strict.trx`、rawcommands/logs/exits、`baseline-comparison.json`、`independent-digest-vectors.json`、`all-issue-status.json/md`、`pr-body.md`。有限source复核发现并关闭Count gap，不能替代parent完整独立验收。Related to #2398 and #2408；未merge/close/deploy/packagepublish。
